planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno (ATmega328P). Serial baud is 9600; framing is line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20 per provided configuration.

The requirement is to output the fixed text 'Hello Arduino' once every 2 seconds. Since business timing belongs in the model, SysML must drive the serial_text_output Boolean gate (initial false) when the 2s condition is met, using elapsed_ms (delta_since_previous_step) to measure time.
No other sensors/displays/actuators were provided in the inventory beyond the stated serial behavior, and no additional wiring/pins were supplied.
